race.comment: TOBIKKO (4) raced consistently through a winter campaign last season, and his only win to date came on a good track. He will be a lot stronger now, and a recent trial placing was very encouraging. With the right run, he will be among the hardest to beat. ZIGGY BAMA (2) has recently joined the local Chris Bieg stable after some strong efforts this season in Victoria. That form will stack up nicely here, and his last race was less than 3 weeks ago at Swan Hill. He has the pole position and can take this out. HOT STATEMENT (1) only had one start last prep in May, and this lightly tried but talented 5YO gelding will be ready to rumble fresh up, especially with a couple of solid trials under his belt. Check the markets for any leads. IT'SANOTHERBATTLE (5) resumed on the classic course here 2 weeks ago and scored by over 7 lengths. She has to be kept safe after a performance like that.
